observations: Photo 0: Open MacBook Pro showing screen with macOS desktop, physical keyboard, and trackpad. Screen displays icons and wallpaper. No visible damage to screen or keyboard from this angle.
Photo 1: Side view of the laptop, showing the hinge, keyboard, and right edge with ports. The screen is off, reflecting the patterned wall. No visible dents or cracks.
Photo 2: Closed laptop from top view, showing silver aluminum lid with Apple logo. No visible scratches or dents. Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI SAMMY AKPURU' is present on all photos.

claims.evidence: The model A1708 is stated by the seller, but not visible in any photo. The year 2017 is not verifiable from photos. 'Clean' is subjective and not proven by photos.

claims.claim: traditional clamshell laptop with physical keyboard
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a clamshell design with a physical keyboard and trackpad, consistent with a MacBook Pro.

risks.risk: Internal damage or non-functioning components (e.g., battery, ports, trackpad, keyboard)
risks.proof: Video showing the laptop turning on, keyboard typing, trackpad scrolling, and ports being used.

risks.risk: Screen damage not visible in photos (e.g., dead pixels, backlight issues, touchbar malfunction if present)
risks.proof: Close-up video of the screen displaying various colors and moving content, including dark and bright scenes.
risks.if_unproven: priced as screen may be faulty

risks.risk: Model or year misrepresentation (e.g., not A1708 or not 2017)
risks.proof: Photo of the bottom of the laptop showing the serial number or model label, or a screenshot of System Report in macOS.

risks.risk: Water damage or liquid exposure (not visible externally)
risks.proof: Photo of the inside of the laptop (if opened) or a video showing the internal components, or a statement from the seller about no water damage.

proof_requests: Photo or video of the bottom of the laptop showing the model number or serial number.
Video showing the laptop turning on, keyboard typing, trackpad working, and ports in use.
Close-up video of the screen displaying various colors and content.
Statement or photo confirming no water damage or internal issues.
response.reason: The model and year are not visible in the photos and must be verified. Internal functionality and screen condition cannot be confirmed from current images. Without proof, the item cannot be priced accurately and risks are unproven.
